g.text: Garage: S3 storage inside the cluster
One node, replication factor 1. Garage is the S3 protocol layer; durability is the NAS's RAID1.
Garage v2 (Rust), distroless image: no shell
consistency mode relaxed on purpose (one node)
so the pod can go Ready
without that the Job could not reach
the pod before it is Ready (a deadlock).
the one iSCSI LUN + the NFS share
single RAID1: that is the real durability
Sources: docs/services/garage.md, docs/known-issues/storage-iscsi-synology.md. Raw manifests, not the Helm chart (the chart is still v1-only).
